About

Engineering systems
that make delivery
repeatable.

I’m Rituraj Chaudhary, a Computer Science student from Dang, Nepal focused on DevOps, cloud infrastructure, and release automation.

I build practical solutions across AWS, Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Jenkins, and Argo CD, with an emphasis on repeatable environments and traceable deployments.

My engineering focus is straightforward: reduce manual work, improve release confidence, and make infrastructure easier to operate.
